# DUM-SDK 0.16.0 Alpha 2

## Releases

- Release files are listed under their own names (`DUM-SDK-Fabric-0.16.0-alpha.2.jar`, its `.sig`, `DUM-SDK-Paper-0.16.0-alpha.2.jar`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`) instead of the labels "Fabric mod (client)", "Paper plugin (server)" and so on. The labels were also removed from the files of 0.15.2 and 0.16.0-alpha.

## Upgrade and validation

No code changes since 0.16.0-alpha; protocol 7. Because versions must match exactly, a 0.16.0-alpha client and a 0.16.0-alpha.2 server do not let each other in: the client offers to install 0.16.0-alpha.2 in its version window. Update the mod and the Paper plugin together. Clients 0.15.x install this release by themselves at the next game start.

Checked: `./gradlew build` and the Release workflow. The release files are the same build as 0.16.0-alpha apart from the version.
